items.currentLimitation: The seven fixed artwork identities, focal crops, title/product layers and play state remain page composition. Candidate primitives are not evidence of native runtime consumption.
items.rationale: Hero art direction and layered composition are brand/page responsibilities.

items.currentLimitation: The official image face, 999px geometry, hover scale and glow are a Welcome-only recipe. A generic DuButton must not imply a reusable primary action.
items.rationale: The official image face and hover choreography are a bounded brand recipe.

items.currentLimitation: Current filters are plain buttons. Their rectangular black/white taxonomy is not a verified DuTabs instance.
items.rationale: Taxonomy tabs are a repeatable interaction family, but the current Tabs variants cannot express this rectangular treatment without replacement markup.

items.currentLimitation: Browse density, square media and no-per-card-CTA policy remain catalog composition; Card + Image are candidates, not current native consumers.
items.rationale: Catalog information architecture and product density should remain host composition.

items.currentLimitation: News, products and events have distinct editorial structures. Primitives may host atoms later but cannot replace the information architecture with one generic Card.
items.rationale: News, product and event modules intentionally retain different information structures.

items.currentLimitation: Grid, radial texture, and alpha endpoints form a bounded paper recipe rather than a DangoUI color token.
items.rationale: Texture layers are a brand composition recipe rather than a reusable component API.

items.currentLimitation: Card rarity/type colors convey game data and must not inherit brand action colors.
items.rationale: Rarity colors encode card-game data and must not inherit global action colors.

items.currentLimitation: DuSelect would nest a second bottom popup inside the existing publish sheet.
items.rationale: A reusable selector needs an inline or caller-owned popup container mode to avoid nested bottom sheets.

items.currentLimitation: Host-wide native input rules can draw a second border and focus ring inside the DangoUI wrapper.
items.workaround: Scoped reset of inner native border, outline, shadow and background
items.rationale: Composite inputs need a documented and testable contract for which layer owns border and focus presentation.

items.currentLimitation: A theme token declared on the document root can be shadowed by a host theme token declared on a nearer page root.
items.workaround: Repeat the semantic bridge on the host theme root with explicit scope
items.rationale: Theme aliases need a supported scoping strategy that remains predictable inside an existing host theme root.

items.currentLimitation: A showcase component can keep importing the previous brand asset after its surrounding theme changes.
items.workaround: Expose one semantic card-back surface and let the active host theme own its rendered asset or CSS treatment
items.rationale: Brand-specific media and generated card-back art belong to the host recipe, but the slot must still be explicit and theme-owned.

items.requestedCapability: theme-owned motion timing and autoplay policy
items.currentLimitation: Literal durations and autoplay intervals survive a palette/theme swap and preserve the previous brand's motion character.
items.workaround: Expose duration, easing and cycle policy as host theme variables and verify computed values in each active theme
items.rationale: Brand motion character belongs to the host recipe; DangoUI should not prescribe page-showcase choreography.
